title: AI Trading App
author: North_Condition8320
selftext:
ONLY Stocks, NOT options / futures / etc..

Planning to build good one.. any suggestions for the strategies please? If we build this I know lots of us will benefit.

E.g.

1. 7am Scans every 30mins till 2pm for: volume > 300k, float > 15m, RVOL > 2.5  
2. 9:30am AI to decide which top 1-3 stocks to be traded for that day  
3. 9:30am onwards till 2pm Entry / Exit / Add Position / Sell Partial / Sell Full Position  
4. Repeat daily

Alpaca is the Broker (good API documentations, Interactive Broker is good too but expensive in terms of commissions)

Day Trader 7am scan, every 30mins till 2pm ET and AI checks/analyze stock details from these data sources (will pay for subscriptions for unlimited and historical data): FMP, Benzinga, Finnhub, Yfinance, StockTwits, PolyMarket

AI Options: Claude AI, OpenAI, Gemini AI and xAI (ONLY, others are not matured yet - on Subscription)

Code with Claude (on Subscription too)

Database: Supabase

Vercel: Web and Domain Hosting

GitHub: Code Repo
